scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && npm run typecheck:content
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/*/tests/*.test.ts apps/server/tests/*.test.ts content/authoring/content.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck:content: tsc --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule content/authoring/*.ts content/intro/starter.ts content/exercises/*/starter.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts
